author: Mario Daniel Ruiz Saavedra
html: I’ve worked on some of those PRs, and yes, Quarkus makes it very easy to just add the annotation yourself, and the Jakarta REST project already has a discussion about this RFC: https://github.com/jakartaee/rest/issues/1345 (some members are very against any addition outside of Roy Fielding’s dissertation, to Jakarta REST). That’s why I didn’t think of adding anything to Quarkus proper, it is way leaner than other frameworks. I have a tracker for QUERY method adoption that I update regularly, I’ll leave the URL here: https://gist.github.com/desiderantes/2c7e657649cb92672d68e580fb69aa1d

author: Hüseyin Akdoğan
html: Thanks for the context and for the tracker. Your Gist maps QUERY adoption across a far wider set of implementations than I covered in the post; had I known about it, I would have linked to it there.
